packageDirectories.versionName: v3.3.0 — CMDT-generated prompt schema for supported wire keys
packageDirectories.versionDescription: Résumé Parser 3.3 bounded generic CMDT runtime: validated direct Resume_Data__c and Work_Experience__c fields become generic prompt, review, and commit envelopes; supported types, duplicate-target rejection, compatible picklists/defaults, and fail-closed disclosure are enforced. It also includes temporary Draft/file cleanup. Version 3.3.0-1 / 04tbm000000j6Z7AAI was built from this runtime with 92% code coverage and promoted to Released. The repository provides a separate exact-version Agent Script lifecycle under agent/, which is not included in the app package.
